verdict.rationale: LM Studio's local-first architecture (offline chat, offline RAG, local model storage) implies user retains full physical control over their data since nothing is sent to a server, giving an implicit form of retention/deletion control (e.g. deleting local files removes all data). However, no evidence documents an explicit retention/deletion feature, settings page, or policy for chat history or logs. missing for 10: explicit UI/CLI documentation for clearing/deleting chat history or configuring data retention, first-party privacy policy statement on data handling, independent confirmation that no data is retained beyond local storage.
